claim: PBISC nominates KIAA0391 as a severity-associated transcriptomic candidate in inferred HSPCs; shared-patient fidelity remains unresolved.

metric.name: patient-level KIAA0391 severity association
metric.unit: Spearman rho; patient meanlog1p(CP10K); explicitly scoped correctedP/q
metric.aggregation: cell-weighted meanlog1p(CP10K) per patient over shared5762 genes; source-specific rankINT for pooled correlations

data_source.notes: All values are from staged canonical CSVs. Full9type permutation BH was not recomputed. The10M MonteCarlo tail upper bound is not a clinical effect CI.

category_order: A: Complete shared-label/shared-gene universe and actual HSPC coverage
B: Real/New/Combined KIAA0391 severity correlations; fixed-score50k percentile95% CI
C: All29 genuine new patients; raw meanlogCP10K; deterministic x-only beeswarm is visual only
D: Analytic BH and10M full-HSPC Bonferroni are distinct correction scopes
E: All24 shared patients; negative observed rho does not support strong fidelity

uncertainty.note: B50,000 fixed-score patient bootstrap; rho source-stratified. Source rankINT maps, generator, annotation and selection fixed.10M permutation B9,999,999 with+1P; Clopper-Pearson MC interval applies only to tail probability.

annotations.text: P/q threshold0.05; correction families are printed explicitly

exceptions.rule: Prefer1-4 panels for a main figure
exceptions.reason: Five panels were explicitly approved to show discovery scope, effect uncertainty, patient distribution, correction family and negative fidelity evidence together.
